method.raw: 16 cases: two source rates x WAV/FLAC5 x paused/playing seek x two positions; recording begins before seek, 1024-frame target-needle correlation; cubic fractional-reference fit at 1/32 frame is a diagnostic, not byte equality or guaranteed seek accuracy.
method.timecode: 180s four independently coded amplitude envelopes; 10ms RMS bins, 2ms template search step, 2s window after 1.2s. Calibration is ideal template self-consistency, not a physical/DSP accuracy guarantee. Per-context request/render times used; no cross-context frame subtraction.
method.load: Two independent real graph factories concurrently in one hidden renderer, each one HTML audio owner, monitor/capture none sink; 600s waits per format plus observation overhead; two Web Workers each nominal 12.5ms busy /37.5ms wait; first phase fixed Key+2/tempo1.1 with native 180s loops, later seek/key changes. Aggregate instrumented stress, not standalone codec RAM/CPU comparison.
method.limits: No physical device/OBS/subjective quality or hardware xrun measurement. Render counter continuity is not proof of hardware underrun absence. Memory includes retained measurements; finite run cannot prove no leak. Content lag after manual timeline changes is not measured against the original start.

failures.description: Initial arithmetic hash produced near-duplicate timecode windows; ideal calibration decoded wrong locations despite correlation >.999. Eight exploratory DSP cases rejected; replaced with avalanche hash, known-position calibration passed.

One 44.1kHz WAV playing seek at 94.731s with Key-2/tempo1.1 produced low-confidence 2s-envelope alignment (~.643) at an unrelated location. Original case retained, not counted as position supported; longer-window same-condition repeat evidence follows separately. Initial waveform envelopes were not retained, so the cause of that specific result cannot be retroactively proven.

method.scope: Isolated real media protocol and audio-graph factory only; synthetic 180s PCM repeated exactly fourfold into 720s assets. No product implementation, migration, eligibility or settings change.
method.continuous: Seven parallel controls: unit tempo; native pitch-preserving tempo1.1; native preservesPitch=false diagnostic; FLAC; native loop; Signalsmith -2; 48k input. Explicit none sinks, no live correlation analysis. Reduced observer retains only source for six controls; DSP control retains raw/monitor/capture. Context elapsed clocks must be distinguished from performance.now wall time.
method.transitions: 32 short cases: native loop versus identical PCM single-file join, two formats, native tempo/preservePitch and DSP on/off, plus 48k and explicit seek. Exact zero and abs<1e-7 near-zero intervals >=16 frames recorded with sample bounds; event snapshots paired to each context origin; not acoustic timing.
method.locator: Legacy midpoint-amplitude 2s/10ms-bin/2ms-step estimator compared to cached algebraically equivalent computation, and six-second multi-candidate windows. Fixed low-confidence windows never count as true wrong playback positions. Delayed-read control injects 0/1500/2500ms before an actual high-byte Range response through the existing dependency; no bytes/headers changed.
method.limits: Finite synthetic none-sink observations do not settle natural-music quality, device/OBS clocks, click perception, hardware underruns or the old anomaly without its original samples. preservesPitch=false and prejoined audio are diagnostic controls, not proposed product defaults or migrations.

capacityLimitedExploration.status: Not accepted as six-minute real-time evidence; all contexts running while render clocks fell tens of seconds behind wall. Receipts retained.
capacityLimitedExploration.changesBeforeRerun: Removed per-sample temporary-array allocation and reduced 21 observer lanes to 9. Cadence recovered within the stated <1s coarse wall/render gate, not proof of sample-accurate wall pacing; no isolated GC/ambient-load attribution.

history.limit: Three repetitions per format of the original eight-step 44.1kHz DSP/seek history. Original unrecorded anomaly remains unresolved even if these do not reproduce.

delayedReadControl.method: Synthetic bounded delay in existing mediaProtocol range-response dependency, same real 206 bytes/headers; fixed legacy window vs event-anchored stable window. This is a fault-injection mechanism control, not retrospective proof of the old unrecorded sample.

clockMapping.method: Per-context elapsed frame clocks paired to performance.now at 50ms ticks; six-second median windows; wall mapping diagnostic, not device/acoustic latency.
clockMapping.interpretation: Apparent ~78ms capture render-clock change largely tracks ~77ms differential clock/wall change; after wall mapping relative-to-source change is ~3ms at 10ms-bin scale. This is not a physical latency measurement; none-sink wall pacing is not exact.

failures.description: Initial seven-graph/21-observer run stayed running but rendered only about 320s during 360s wall; not used for full-length timing inference. Preserved separately.

findings: Turtle bridge saved30s output/OBS zero runs116 and1; direct0 and0. Common150–170s bridge18 and1, direct0 and0; source first2/pre zeros0 throughout. Supports whole-path sensitivity, not FIFO as unique cause.

Both virtual capture APIs had no exact stereo zero runs in common150–170s. Process capture each had one1504frame zero near the start of saved30s, localized to its first second with extra nonzero residual; startup/reinitialization is a confound, not a proven steady-state or42ms buffering diagnosis.
